preconditions: The four functions are invoked on a path where the game's directory globals (dword_5EC420 TrackDir, dword_5EC3D8 SeasonDir, dword_5EC408 base override) are either configured or null; a null value falls back to byte_5EA438.
sub_4D0110 requires the active vehicle table dword_7C54F0 to be populated for the per-vehicle decoration loop, with the entry count read from dword_5C329C.
sub_4D1450 requires the `this` object to expose an indexed string accessor (up to 52 slots); a null slot entry terminates the loop.
sub_4D8AB0 requires `this` to carry normalized screen dimensions at +0xE4/+0xE8 (this[57]/this[58]) used to configure each loaded resource.
sub_4DC450 requires a non-null a1 and a3 to perform work; with either null it returns 1 immediately.
postconditions: sub_4D0110 leaves the scene-state object with the vehicle count at +0x0 and a populated 132-byte-strided decoration array at +0x4, loads up to three config/archive objects and releases them, and returns 0 on the early cdb/cmaps failure paths.
sub_4D1450 loads team/driver/box logo BMP textures for each non-null slot entry and releases the opened container handle before returning its teardown result.

sub_4D8AB0 populates the four resource globals dword_8AD388/dword_8AD38C/dword_8AD390/dword_8AD394 with 133120-byte objects whose +0x5C/+0x60 fields equal this[57]/this[58], and returns the last sub_53CFE0 result or 1.
sub_4DC450 leaves the global path buffer byte_5EA438 holding the copied directory (and, on the a4 path, the stripped filename), and returns 1 on success or 0 on a failed filename match.
side_effects: sub_4D0110 allocates the 132*count+4 byte decoration array (via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper 0x00587C03) and stores its pointer into the scene-state object.
sub_4D0110 writes a per-slot flag word into grid_entry+0x4 for every vehicle slot, and constructs/loads grid-girl and grid-sign meshes, sign textures and vertex-buffer resources.
sub_4D0110 releases the three loaded config objects via PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval (0x0053CE40).
sub_4D1450 mutates local state only and releases the opened container handle via PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval.
sub_4D8AB0 releases a previously loaded first resource via sub_4D8FB0 when present, and writes this[57]/this[58] into each freshly loaded resource at +0x5C/+0x60.
sub_4DC450 writes into the global path buffer byte_5EA438 (directory truncation, filename copy, extension strip) and calls StringRegistry/StringMatchWithFlagSet against it.

disputes.description: Architecture prose labels these 'music/audio handles' at DERIVED tier, but raw C only shows them allocated (133120 bytes) and configured at +0x5C/+0x60. The resource type is unresolved, not audio.
The name implies audio, yet in sub_4D1450 the call returns an object whose DataEntryAccessor string supplies a 4-char logo-name suffix. The audio interpretation is unverified.

The 132-byte-strided entry and its +0x68/+0x74/+0x78/+0x7C/+0x80 fields are inferred from relative offset usage in the packet IR; widths are guessed and were not confirmed against raw source in this candidate.

unresolved: Cut-edge targets listed in packet.external_contract_dependencies are required dependencies whose contracts lie outside this packet and are not optional: 0x0044C4C0, 0x004A1FD0, 0x004A21D0, 0x004A22D0, 0x004A27D0, 0x004A2800, 0x004D0B00, 0x004D10E0, 0x004D1410, 0x004D7A50, 0x004D7AA0, 0x004D8FB0, 0x004DC770, 0x004DD550, 0x0053C5B0, 0x0053CE40, 0x0053CFE0, 0x005450E0, 0x00545250, 0x00545930, 0x00546AA0, 0x005472B0, 0x0054B4D0, 0x0054C230, 0x00552FD0, 0x005665B0, 0x00566650, 0x00566E40, 0x00567120, 0x00567970, 0x00568210, 0x00587DD0, 0x005884ED, 0x0058969D.

The packet mixes calling conventions: sub_4D0110, sub_4D1450 and sub_4D8AB0 are __thiscall on a this pointer, while sub_4DC450 is __fastcall(int a1, char a2, const char *a3, char a4). The signature field is 'unknown' because one value cannot describe all four.

sub_4D0110's scene-state object and the 132-byte per-vehicle decoration entry layout are only implied by relative offsets; entry+0x68/+0x74/+0x78/+0x7C/+0x80 widths and the purpose of the word flag at entry+0x4 are semantic guesses, not proven.
sub_4D0110 allocates the decoration array but no teardown/free path for that array is evidenced in this packet (only the config objects are released).
The exact contracts of the external call targets sub_53CBC0 (open/probe), sub_53CFE0 (resource loader), sub_4A22D0, SingleFunctionDispatch_10e0 (0x004D10E0), sub_567120 and sub_54B4D0 are unknown.

For sub_4D8AB0, MaskedFieldSetter(0, 192) on each loaded resource and the meaning of the 133120-byte allocation are unresolved; the relationship between the sub_53CBC0 probe object and PhysicsObjectLinkedListRemoval teardown is inferred, not evidenced.

For sub_4D1450, the sub_53CBC0 handle teardown relationship is inferred; which slot entries correspond to team vs driver logos is not determinable from this packet, and the meaning of TextureAdjuster arguments (1, 0) is unknown.

For sub_4DC450, a1 is used only as a null check, and the semantics of the match-criteria parameter a2 and the copy-and-strip flag a4 depend on the caller (0x004DC770); internal behavior of StringRegistry, StringMatchWithFlagSet, sub_546AA0, sub_589901 and RelativeStringCopy is inferred from names.

Global dword_8AFE64 is flagged in every function's unresolved evidence but does not appear in any raw source text; dword_8AD3B4 (flagged in sub_4D1450) also has no raw-source occurrence. Their roles are unknown.
